# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from contract/openapi.json.
     Do not edit by hand: `pnpm check:docs` fails when this drifts. -->

Every read and write OpenOKR offers, 345 of them, grouped by domain.

This page is generated from `contract/openapi.json`, which is generated
from the action registry. The same registry produces the REST surface, the
command line, the agent tool catalogue and the chat commands, so anything
listed here is reachable from all of them on the same terms.

See [how the API works](README.md) for authentication, scopes, errors and
the machine-readable document.

## Reading this table

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Action** | The name in the registry. The command line and the agent catalogue use it verbatim |
| **Method and path** | Under `/api/v1` |
| **Class** | `reads` needs the read scope. `writes` and `destroys` need write. A token is never granted destructive by default |

## agents

| Action | Method and path | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `agents.bindScope`<br/>Grants an agent's member group a binding on one named resource — never workspace-wide. | `POST /api/v1/agents/bindScope` | writes |
| `agents.cancelRun`<br/>Cancels a run that is still planning or running. | `POST /api/v1/agents/cancelRun` | writes |

| `agents.startRun`<br/>Starts a run for an agent against an already-decomposed task list. | `POST /api/v1/agents/startRun` | writes |

| `tasks.delete`<br/>Soft-deletes a task, its assignments and its checklist. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/delete` | destroys |
| `tasks.linkedWork`<br/>Linked work per key result for one cycle: two counts, and the sentence when they disagree with the measure. | `GET /api/v1/tasks/linkedWork` | reads |
| `tasks.list`<br/>Tasks, optionally only the caller's own or only the ones due by a date. | `GET /api/v1/tasks/list` | reads |
| `tasks.move`<br/>Moves a card to a column and a slot, under a lock so two drags cannot lose one. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/move` | writes |
| `tasks.read`<br/>One task with its assignees and its checklist. Drives screen S-28. | `GET /api/v1/tasks/read` | reads |
| `tasks.removeChecklistItem`<br/>Removes one checklist line. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/removeChecklistItem` | writes |
| `tasks.setChecklistItem`<br/>Ticks or unticks one checklist line. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/setChecklistItem` | writes |
| `tasks.unassign`<br/>Removes an assignment and the edit access it granted. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/unassign` | writes |
| `tasks.update`<br/>Updates a task's own fields. Its position is moved with tasks.move, not here. | `POST /api/v1/tasks/update` | writes |

## tokens

| Action | Method and path | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `tokens.approveDevice`<br/>Approve or deny a terminal that asked to sign in as you. | `POST /api/v1/tokens/approveDevice` | writes |
| `tokens.create`<br/>Mint an API token, shown once, carrying your own authority. | `POST /api/v1/tokens/create` | writes |
| `tokens.mine`<br/>The signed-in member's own API tokens, newest first. | `GET /api/v1/tokens/mine` | reads |
| `tokens.pendingDevice`<br/>The terminal request one device code names, if it is still open. | `GET /api/v1/tokens/pendingDevice` | reads |
| `tokens.revoke`<br/>Revoke one of your own API tokens. | `POST /api/v1/tokens/revoke` | destroys |

## workflow

| Action | Method and path | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `workflow.addIssue`<br/>Adds a ranked strategic issue to a cycle's phase 2 list. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/addIssue` | writes |
| `workflow.addPriority`<br/>Adds a phase 3 priority, optionally promoting the issue it came from. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/addPriority` | writes |
| `workflow.calibrate`<br/>Records the one mid-cycle calibration a cycle is allowed (METHOD.md §7.6). | `POST /api/v1/workflow/calibrate` | writes |
| `workflow.distributePack`<br/>Records that the input pack reached people, which the §2.6 lead time is measured from. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/distributePack` | writes |
| `workflow.publish`<br/>Publishes the set, refusing while any of the six gates is red or cannot be evaluated. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/publish` | writes |
| `workflow.read`<br/>A cycle's phase completion, its six publish gates and the rows they are computed from. | `GET /api/v1/workflow/read` | reads |
| `workflow.setBaselineHealth`<br/>Records phase 2's KPI reading in the three §8.5 columns: stable, declining, business as usual. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/setBaselineHealth` | writes |
| `workflow.setCapacityNotes`<br/>Records what was cut, which publish gate 5 reads (§5.5: if nothing was cut, capacity was not checked). | `POST /api/v1/workflow/setCapacityNotes` | writes |
| `workflow.setIssueImpact`<br/>Reranks a strategic issue. The list is ordered by impact. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/setIssueImpact` | writes |
| `workflow.setPackItem`<br/>Marks one of the seven §2.6 input-pack items gathered, with a note. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/setPackItem` | writes |
| `workflow.setRevalidation`<br/>Records the quarterly revalidation: the frame holds, or changed with a note. | `POST /api/v1/workflow/setRevalidation` | writes |

## workspace

| Action | Method and path | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace.exportArchive`<br/>Exports the whole workspace as a versioned, checksummed, encrypted archive. Audited. | `POST /api/v1/workspace/exportArchive` | writes |
| `workspace.finishOnboarding`<br/>Mark the workspace's own setup as finished, so the wizard stops offering itself. | `POST /api/v1/workspace/finishOnboarding` | writes |
| `workspace.importArchive`<br/>Imports a workspace from an encrypted archive, with a dry-run mode that predicts the real import. | `POST /api/v1/workspace/importArchive` | writes |
| `workspace.overview`<br/>The current workspace and the member reading it. | `GET /api/v1/workspace/overview` | reads |
| `workspace.provision`<br/>Create a workspace and its first member for a newly registered person. | `POST /api/v1/workspace/provision` | writes |
| `workspace.rename`<br/>Change a workspace's display name. | `POST /api/v1/workspace/rename` | writes |
| `workspace.setLifecycle`<br/>Move a cloud workspace between active, suspended and closed (P8-T02c). | `POST /api/v1/workspace/setLifecycle` | writes |
| `workspace.setState`<br/>Set the workspace to active, read-only or frozen (TECHNICAL-PLAN §4.1, the freeze overlay). | `POST /api/v1/workspace/setState` | writes |
